# TC.SoundPage

Source: public `api/` declarations. [All public types and globals](../types.md).

<a id="symbol-TC.SoundPage"></a>

### TC.SoundPage

One complete sound-discovery page; no total/approximate count or query handle.
Empty means sounds={} with next absent. Even a full final page omits next.

### next (optional)

Last emitted path only when another matching valid path exists; pass as after.

```text
string
```

### sounds

Unique runtime-valid paths sorted bytewise, at most speaker_sound_page_size.

```text
(string)[]
```
